title: Ensuring successful treatment after a stay in hospital
summary:
The participants are recruited at the Oldenburg Clinic and the Pius Hospital Oldenburg. As part of the project, geriatric patients undergoing inpatient treatment and their caring relatives are examined. The first data collection takes place during the hospital stay. The second and third surveys take place 3 and 6 months after discharge in the home environment.
The aim of this study is to identify trajectories of social and physical activities and their influencing factors. In addition, the insights gained are to be translated into a concept for lifestyle interventions to improve the everyday coping of patients and caring relatives.

interventions.name:
As part of the project, we are investigating geriatric, multimorbid patients undergoing inpatient treatment and their caring relatives. The first data collection takes place during hospitalisation. The second and third surveys take place 3 and 6 months after discharge in the home environment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Geriatric patients over 70 years of age with multimorbidity or over 80 years of age
- People being treated in the cardiac surgery, geriatrics or geriatric trauma center at Oldenburg Hospital or
- Persons being treated in the orthopaedics or trauma surgery department at Pius Hospital Oldenburg
- In addition, if available, a primary contact person/caring relative will be recruited.
Exclusion criteria:
- Life expectancy < 6 months
- Bedridden
- Necessity of permanent use of a wheelchair
- Persons living permanently in a nursing home before the inpatient stay
- Unstable medical, neurological or psychiatric illnesses
- Persons who are unable to understand the contents of the study
- Place of residence outside a radius of 40 km around Oldenburg
